quote.text: Whenever you see someone holding political power, set against it the fact that you yourself have no need of power. Whenever you see someone wealthy, observe what you have instead of that. For if you have nothing in its place, you are in a miserable state; but if you have the absence of the need to have wealth, realize that you have something greater and much more valuable. One man has a beautiful wife, you have the absence of longing for a beautiful wife. Do you think these are little things? How much would these very people – the wealthy, the powerful, the ones who live with beautiful women – pay for the ability to look down on wealth and power and those very women whom they adore and get?
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that as a parent, the true wealth lies in nurturing the inner spirit of your children—not in accumulating external symbols of success. Embrace the inner peace that comes from not envying what others display, and model a life of mindful satisfaction.
    • By valuing simplicity and emotional strength over material comparisons, you create a home environment where love and honesty flourish. This focus on what truly matters helps your children learn that fulfillment comes from inner virtue rather than external validation.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, true power is demonstrated through the absence of a need for dominance. A leader who is secure in their own nature realizes that the pursuit of external power often clouds sound judgment and ethical responsibility.
    • Embracing modesty and inner strength allows you to lead by example. By disregarding the transient allure of wealth and status, you inspire trust and loyalty, encouraging others to value authenticity and wisdom over mere titles.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, focus on delivering genuine value rather than chasing market trends or external accolades. Recognize that the absence of a desperate need for success enables you to innovate with clarity and purpose.
    • By prioritizing inner goals—such as customer satisfaction and meaningful progress—over superficial metrics, you cultivate a product culture that values authenticity. This mindset leads to sustainable improvements and a lasting impact on the market.
